# Suraj Kushvaha — Software Engineer

> Suraj Kushvaha is a software engineer based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, with a B.Tech in Computer Engineering and 3+ years in the SaaS industry. He builds production Angular frontends and Rust/Node.js backend microservices, and builds AI and 3D web systems from scratch in his own time. Philosophy: "I'd rather build it from scratch than import it, just to understand how it works underneath."

- Website: https://surajkushvaha.vercel.app/
- Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India
- Current role: Software Engineer at Asite Solution Pvt Ltd
- Email: suraj04patel@gmail.com

## About

By day, Suraj builds production Angular frontend architecture and Node.js/Rust backend microservices in the SaaS world, with deep experience in web accessibility (WCAG) and PDF/document tooling. By night, he builds complete systems from scratch: AI VTubers, custom OCR pipelines, an AI architecture-design platform, and a published game. He has also done research most people skip — training custom OCR models (Detectron2, Mask R-CNN, PyTorch ViTs) instead of calling an API, prototyping a fully local AI-companion animation pipeline over 2,000+ motion-capture clips, and building his own review and test-generation tooling for AI coding assistants.

## Tech stack

- Frontend: TypeScript, Angular (17–19: standalone components, signals, OnPush), Three.js, HTML/CSS/SCSS
- Backend: Node.js, NestJS, Rust, Python
- Data & infra: PostgreSQL, Prisma, Docker, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Redis, Supabase
- Specialties: web accessibility (WCAG 2.2), PDF/OCR pipelines (Apryse/PDFTron, PaddleOCR), 3D/VRM web (GLTF/FBX), Tauri desktop packaging
- AI/ML: Gemini API, Vercel AI SDK, PyTorch, Detectron2, vector search, Ollama / local LLMs, MCP

## Projects

- [ProjectArch](https://surajkushvaha.vercel.app/): AI-assisted architectural design platform for the Indian market — map-based land drawing (Leaflet/Mapbox + OSM Overpass), a custom DCR/zoning rule engine, AI-generated 2D floor plans, and 3D extrusion with Three.js. (Private, in development.)
- [Jessica](https://github.com/thanksforfree/jessica): Autonomous AI VTuber with a real-time 3D VRM avatar driven by the Gemini API, a mood/expression/gesture state machine, and live YouTube chat + donation reactions.
- [RepoLens](https://repo-lens-one.vercel.app): Explore any GitHub codebase as a living, interactive map instead of a static folder tree — paste a repo, fly through its architecture, and ask questions in plain language. Built with Next.js and the Vercel AI SDK (Claude). Live: https://repo-lens-one.vercel.app · Code: https://github.com/surajkushvaha/RepoLens
- [projectK](https://github.com/surajkushvaha/projectK): Document management & viewer platform — Angular + NestJS + Apryse/PDFTron WebViewer with role-based access control.
- [ecommerce-backend](https://github.com/surajkushvaha/ecommerce-backend): Modular NestJS e-commerce API — auth, cart, orders, payments, Prisma ORM, JWT/Passport, e2e tests.
- [OCR Microservice](https://github.com/surajkushvaha/ocr_microservice): FastAPI + PaddleOCR document intelligence service with async Celery/Redis processing.
- [colored-beautiful-logger](https://github.com/surajkushvaha/colored-beautiful-logger): Published TypeScript logging library — log levels, file rotation, custom ANSI/RGB colored output.
- [Dharmshankara](https://theworstgamecompany.itch.io/dharmshankara): Published 2D parody rage-game with combo combat and a karma system, Tauri-packaged for Web, Windows, and Android.
- Neural Coppelia (research): bone-data analysis over 2,000+ Mixamo motion-capture clips, vector-DB animation retrieval, and LLM-blended animation layering scoped to run locally on a 6GB VRAM GPU.
- Multi-modal LLM (research): a small-scale multi-modal model built from a GPT-2 backbone extended to take text and image inputs together.

## Experience

Asite (Ahmedabad, India), Feb 2023 – present — four roles at one company:
- Software Engineer (Jul 2025 – present): Rust backend microservices for auth, payments, Kafka event streaming, Elasticsearch search, and SSO/SAML; led the Angular 19 standalone-components + signals + OnPush migration; frontend performance work (trackBy, RxJS debouncing, XHR cancellation).
- Associate Software Engineer (Jul 2024 – Aug 2025): platform-wide accessibility service for WCAG-compliant features; accessibility retrofit of a legacy system with semantic HTML.
- Trainee Software Engineer (Jun 2023 – Aug 2024): Apryse (PDFTron) WebViewer integration; OCR text extraction with Tesseract.js and document conversion workflows.
- UI Intern (Feb 2023 – May 2023): Angular UI components in an agile workflow.
